card: Adds feature_dbcrash_replay.py, a deterministic functional test for Chainstate::ReplayBlocks that runs in base CI in roughly one second. Block replay recovery was previously only tested by feature_dbcrash.py, which relies on randomized crash points, takes several minutes, and is excluded from PR CI. The author demonstrates that this test deterministically catches off-by-one bugs in both rollback and roll-forward loops in validation.cpp.
changed_since_previous: None; previous description was generated without the patch.
evidence: PR description: feature_dbcrash.py 'takes several minutes and is in EXTENDED_SCRIPTS, so it never runs on PRs.'
PR description: feature_dbcrash_replay.py runs in ~1s and deterministically catches two mutant off-by-one errors demonstrated in validation.cpp rollback and roll-forward loops.
problem: Chainstate::ReplayBlocks is currently only exercised by feature_dbcrash.py, which uses randomized crash points, takes several minutes, and only runs in extended test suites outside PR CI. Off-by-one bugs or regressions in block replay recovery can easily slip into master without detection.

risk.why: Test-only addition to BASE_SCRIPTS; any failure would only cause CI flakes or false test failures.

summary: Adds feature_dbcrash_replay.py to standard functional test runs to test Chainstate::ReplayBlocks deterministically. The test forces an immediate crash during a coins cache flush following a chain reorg, then restarts the node to exercise rollback of the abandoned branch and roll-forward to the new tip.
